newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends up on central bank intervention.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends up on central bank intervention.

text.p: The won closed higher versus the dollar on Friday, boosted by the central bank's dollar selling, traders said.
The bank stepped in soon after the market opened at 847.50, the lowest level since a market average system was introduced in March 1990. But the bank denied the move as it routinely does.
The won closed at 846.80, traders said, far off from the day's opening.
The central bank's dollar sales in early morning pushed the won to an intraday high of 846.40. But rising demand for the dollar helped ease the won's gain.
Dealers forecast import settlements would pressure the won early next week.
The base mid-rate is seen at 846.70/80 for Monday, compared with 846.70 for Friday.
